per_candidate.id: s2:Where Do Stars Explode in the ISM?—The Distribution of Dense Gas around Evolved
s2:PHAST. The Panchromatic Hubble Andromeda Southern Treasury. I. Ultraviolet and O

rationale: Paper 2501.02056 directly investigates the amount of cool gas in the circumgalactic medium of dwarf galaxies, contributing evidence on the gas involved in galactic processes. However, it does not fully address the timing of gas enrichment and exchange processes.
